name: Safekeeping Account 20
definition: Identification and information about a securities account and balance.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the securities account between the account owner and the account servicer.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SubAccountIdentification.name: Sub Account Identification
SubAccountIdentification.definition: Identification of a subaccount within the safekeeping account.

InstructedBalance.name: Instructed Balance
InstructedBalance.definition: Quantity of securities to which this instruction applies.

RightsHolderMultiplicity1Guideline.definition: It is recommended that RightsHolder is only present more than once if there is joint ownership.

BalanceQall1Rule.definition: If SubAccountIdentification is present, then InstructedBalance/Balance/Code "QALL" (AllSecurities) is not allowed in any occurrence of InstructedBalance.

AccountIdentificationOrBlockChainAddress.definition: Either AccountIdentification or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present then AccountIdentification must be absent.
If AccountIdentification is present, then BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.
